evidence: The crystalline properties of the films were characterized via Raman spectroscopy, x-ray diffraction, cross-sectional transmission microscopy, and atomic force microscopy, which confirmed the high quality of the films. The XRD pattern of a representative Bi2Se3 thin film of a 32-nm-thick film is shown in Fig. 2. All the diffraction peaks in the figure can be indexed to a rhombohedral Bi2Se3 structure that produces the (0003) family of peaks (JCPDS number 33-0214).
